growth_signal.value: Over half a million property views a month, as the company says.

entry.idea: Many homes are sold quietly before they are advertised, so buyers miss them; Quiet Listings shows these off-market and pre-market homes and hidden prices.
entry.lesson: Make hidden information easy to see, and give it away free to build a crowd first.
entry.name: Quiet Listings

growth.reason: Company says it grew fast to half a million monthly views, but the number comes only from the company.

market.reason: Housing is a huge need, but this product so far covers one country.

tech.reason: It is a listings site; the edge is the access to off-market homes, which others could copy.

sources.title: The startup uncovering hidden property prices
Quiet Listings Launches to Give Buyers Early Access to Off-Market and Pre-Market Properties
Quiet Listings Expands Beyond Off-Market Property Following Rapid National Growth

entry.twist: It is free for buyers, sellers and agents, and it opens up a part of the market that used to be closed.
entry.who_pays: Nobody pays today, since it is free for buyers, sellers and agents; the sources do not say how it will earn money.
entry.why_now: Buyers want early access and price facts, and the platform says it grew fast after its November 2025 launch.
